structure: Part 14 mined all 21 traces of hub-picker.fit.spec.js that its partition names (spec read in full for titles and assertions). Trace folders are cited by the 5-hex hash in their folder name (addresses-fit-hub-picker.f-<hash>-...). Addresses hub: 0e373 (:65 renders five party rows and copy), 40e50 (:86 back link to overview), 5440d (:91 completing every party marks the task Complete; also walks all five pickers in turn), 69cde (:111 axe scan of the hub). Who is asked for a CPH number: 7c6d1 (:128 Salmo salar, CPH row shown), 2e8c6 (:142 Equus caballus, no CPH row). Party picker per role, three tests per role (render copy and table :158, no-selection validation :186, save and persist :199): Place of origin 3516b/18c1d/c3455, Consignor or exporter 609f3/7a97a/b1843, Consignee 84659/6d854/1914e, Importer 5344f/db145/8a088, Place of destination 59836/4f0fa/fc0b5. Every trace was opened and its full action list taken; the set-up before the hub (stub sign-in, start notification, origin France / No, commodity search and pick, number of animals 1, back to Overview) is shared harness and belongs to other parts, so only the commodity choice that gates the CPH row is claimed here. Default commodity for every test except the two CPH tests is Felis catus. Pages in this slice, in order: Overview (task 'Roles and addresses' under '5. Consignment parties') -> Consignment addresses hub (/notifications/{ref}/addresses) -> one of five party pickers (/place-of-origin/select, /consignors/select, /consignees/select, /importers/select, /destinations/select) -> back to the hub on save -> Overview on the hub's Save and continue. Conditional: the CPH number row on the hub appears for fish and not for horses or cats. Snapshots rendered from each trace's DOM; network log read for every save (the browser only sees the frontend; backend and address-book calls are server-side and do not appear). Pages are entirely govuk-frontend components apart from the app-journey-strip status strip. Not reached in this slice: picker search, View details expansion, pagination, Edit details (part 15), the CPH number page, the hub's Save and return to overview and Cancel actions, and an In progress task status; each is recorded as a gap.

The spec's own comment says design release 1 asks every consignment for a CPH number except named commodity codes, with 0101 (horses) one of two let off; the trace shows cats are let off too, so either the cat code is the second exemption or the rule differs.

claims.quote: Design release 1 asks every consignment for a CPH number and names the commodity codes that escape the question, so the row is the default and its absence is the exception.
